spec.mechanism: Implied volatility exceeds realized volatility on average and the VIX futures curve is in contango most of the time, so a short position in VIX short-term futures (long SVXY) earns the variance risk premium and the roll; it carries crash risk, which a term-structure filter (flat in backwardation), a VIX cap and hard loss rules bound. Added to a volatility-managed index core it raises the Sharpe ratio if the premium is not just the core's equity beta.
